column1: # ci/OSV_ALLOW.tsv — deliberate, dated exceptions for ci/osv_scan.py
# A row matches a finding when the package matches and the row's id is the finding's id or one of its
# aliases.  WHEN THE DATE PASSES THE SCAN FAILS — that is the point: an exception has to be re-argued,
# not inherited.  Do not add a row without a reason that a stranger could check.
# W1183 (2026-11-22) dismissed the glib alert on GitHub with the same argument as below.  W1184 tightened
# the evidence: `array_iter_str` (the only constructor of VariantStrIter) has ZERO call sites in every
# crate source this graph downloads, so the unsound code is not merely uncalled by our files — it is never
# instantiated anywhere in the tree.  The expiry forces a fresh look at gtk-rs 0.20 when the quarter ends.
